name: build a numpy-backed cpython c extension into an importable compiled module
definition: Compile a C extension in place so Python can import it as a native module exposing the intended functions.
failure_mode: Module not built, built as pure Python, or missing functions fails import/attribute checks.

name: create an ISO9660 image embedding a toolchain directory
definition: Generate a boot-mountable ISO containing the needed compiler runtime files and attach it as the guest cdrom.
failure_mode: ISO missing, un-mountable, or does not contain the compiler.

name: cross-compile a small C game engine to a mips elf binary
definition: drive a mips cross toolchain to build the game source into an executable elf for the target architecture
failure_mode: missing toolchain or link errors leave a wrong binary

name: inspect and exploit a (broker) messaging endpoint (unauthenticated reachability, discovery, injection)
definition: inspect and exploit a (broker) messaging endpoint (unauthenticated reachability, discovery, injection)
failure_mode: Missing the endpoint/protocol discovery leaves the agent unable to interact with the target.
